source_validation.finding: The donor explicitly states that its EffectGate zulassen path never blocks a tool; rejected, unchecked, duplicate or timeout cases are bookkeeping while the tool proceeds. Therefore donor EffectGate is not pre-side-effect enforcement authority.

PreToolUse writes a newly generated effect_id to active_turns.effect_id keyed by session_id; PostToolUse later reads that mutable session pointer. This is structurally ambiguous under interleaved same-session tool calls even though runtime serialization remains a counterhypothesis.

Completion rejects an effect proof only when status equals lowercase 'fehler'; current states such as ABGELEHNT, WIEDERHOLUNG, UNGEPRUEFT or FEHLGESCHLAGEN are not explicitly fail-closed by this predicate.
A textual test:<exit_code>:<description> proof is accepted on exit_code == '0' without immutable runner, command, source, environment, output or invocation identity.

PostToolUse can hash resulting file bytes or process output and record an execution-result receipt, but this is bounded tool-result evidence and must not be promoted to arbitrary external-world effect verification.

effect_authority.rule: Frankenstein 2.0 must separate EffectAdmission/Audit from a deterministic pre-side-effect EffectDecision that can actually deny execution. The donor nonblocking EffectGate may contribute provenance/idempotency/journal ideas only.

invocation_identity.rule: Every mutating operation must be keyed by an immutable call-scoped invocation identity such as tool_use_id/call_id plus session/agent/workpackage/generation and request digest. A mutable session-scoped effect_id pointer is forbidden as the sole Pre/Post correlation key.

execution_receipt.rule: Preserve tool-specific post-use hashes as ExecutionReceipt evidence, bound to exact invocation/source/policy/generation. ExecutionReceipt is distinct from WorldEffectVerification.

world_effect_verification.rule: External-effect classes require effect-specific verification semantics. Transport or tool success alone cannot mint world-state success; uncertain post-submission outcomes remain OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

completion.rule: CompletionDecision must use an explicit typed success allowlist over invocation-bound receipts. FAILED, DENIED, UNCHECKED, DUPLICATE, UNKNOWN, STALE and unbound textual test claims fail closed. Legacy test:0 strings are historical evidence format only, not sufficient completion authority.

preserved_contradictions.a: The donor section is named EffectGate and computes admission-like statuses.
preserved_contradictions.b: The same source explicitly states it never blocks Claude Code tool execution.

preserved_contradictions.a: Source correlation uses one mutable active_turns.effect_id per session.
preserved_contradictions.b: The exact installed scheduler may serialize relevant state-changing hook triplets strongly enough to avoid an observed overwrite.

preserved_contradictions.a: Completion comments describe mechanical evidence checking.
preserved_contradictions.b: The executable effect-status predicate is legacy and the test:0 format is not source/environment/invocation bound.

p0: Introduce deterministic pre-side-effect deny capable EffectDecision distinct from audit/journal bookkeeping.
Bind PreToolUse/PostToolUse by call-scoped tool_use_id or equivalent immutable invocation identity; preserve session_id only as parent context.
Replace completion proof with typed success allowlist plus immutable ExecutionReceipt identity; reject unbound test:0 and all non-success/unknown states.
Keep ExecutionReceipt and WorldEffectVerification distinct; unknown external effect outcome remains UNKNOWN.
trigger4_feed.p1_discriminator: On an authorized non-provider surface, run a harmless same-session overlapping two-call hook interleaving test. PASS requires exact tool_use_id -> effect_id -> PostToolUse receipt pairing with no cross-association; serialization may be accepted only if directly observed and bound to the installed build/config.
